name: TextFrame2
description: Represents the text frame in a Shape or ShapeRange object. Contains the text in the text frame and exposes properties and methods that control the alignment and anchoring of the text frame.
remarks: Use the TextFrame2 property of the Shape and ShapeRange objects to return a TextFrame2 object.
example:
Set pptSlide = ActivePresentation.Slides(1)
With pptSlide.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 0, 0, 250, 140).TextFrame2
 .TextRange.Text = "Here is some sample text"
 .MarginBottom = 10
 .MarginLeft = 10
 .MarginRight = 10
 .MarginTop = 10
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the TextFrame2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only. Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the calling object. Read-only.

properties.name: MarginBottom
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the bottom of the text frame and the bottom of the inscribed rectangle of the shape that contains the text. Read/write.

properties.name: MarginLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the left edge of the text frame and the left edge of the inscribed rectangle of the shape that contains the text. Read/write.

properties.name: MarginRight
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the right edge of the text frame and the right edge of the inscribed rectangle of the shape that contains the text. Read/write.

properties.name: MarginTop
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the top of the text frame and the top of the inscribed rectangle of the shape that contains the text. Read/write.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets text orientation. Read/write.

properties.name: HorizontalAnchor
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal alignment of text in a text frame. Read/write.

properties.name: VerticalAnchor
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical alignment of text in a text frame. Read/write.

properties.name: PathFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the path type for the specified text frame. Read/write.

properties.name: WarpFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the warp format (how the text is warped) for the specified text frame. Read/write.

properties.name: WordArtformat
properties.description: Returns or sets the WordArt type for the specified text frame. Read/write.

properties.name: WordWrap
properties.description: Determines whether lines of text break automatically to fit inside the shape. Read/write.

properties.name: AutoSize
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the size of the specified shape is changed automatically to fit text within its boundaries. Read/write.

properties.name: ThreeD
properties.description: Returns a ThreeDFormat object that represents the three-dimensional formatting of the parent shape. Read-only.

properties.name: HasText
properties.description: Indicates whether the shape that contains the specified text frame has text associated with it. Read-only.

properties.name: TextRange
properties.description: Sets the text for a range of nodes in a SmartArt object. Read-only.

properties.name: Column
properties.description: Returns the Column object that represents the columns of the specified text frame. Read-only.

properties.name: Ruler
properties.description: Returns a Ruler2 object that represents the ruler for the specified text. Read-only.

properties.name: NoTextRotation
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that specifies if the text on a shape is rotated if the shape itself is being rotated. Read/write.

methods.name: DeleteText
methods.description: Deletes the text from a text frame and all the associated properties of the text, including font attributes.
